description: OSCAL SAR finding target-ids and the NIST control the importer groups them under, read by the Go (shared_test.go) and TypeScript (converter.test.ts) tests. controlId is what ConfirmedControlID / confirmedControlId return: the lowercase OSCAL control id when the target, ignoring ASCII letter case, is a control optionally followed by dot-separated parts and an _obj or _smt suffix, and NIST defines that control at any supported revision; otherwise empty.
